item.title: YouTube’s first video belongs in a museum. Now it’s in one.
item.description: As YouTube celebrates its 20th birthday, it has become a cultural emblem, and a major museum is recognizing the platform's important role in the history of mass media. London's Victoria and Albert Museum has acquired the video file for "Me at the zoo," YouTube's first-ever upload. "Me at the zoo" is now on display at the V&A's Design 1900-Now Gallery, which examines innovative artifacts from the past 120 years.
